metadata.UseScript: SetStatus("Target");for(int i=0;i<3;i++){Resentment("1");}if(Object.Count>0){var t=Object[0];var buffs=t.GetBuffs();if(buffs!=null){var neg=buffs.Where(x=>x!=null&&x.buffConfig!=null&&x.buffConfig.dataConfig.data["Type"]=="负面").ToArray();foreach(var b in neg){SetStatusById(t.InstanceId);AddBuff(b.buffConfig.BuffId,"1");}int nt=neg.Select(x=>x.buffConfig.BuffId).Distinct().Count();var re=t.GetBuff(DataId.buff_resentment);int rv=re==null?0:re.buffConfig.Level;if(rv*nt>t.CurHp){SetStatusById(t.InstanceId);Damage(t.CurHp.ToString(),"True");}}}
metadata.NativeUseScript: SetStatus("Target");for(int i=0;i<3;i++){Resentment("1");}if(Object.Count>0){var t=Object[0];var buffs=t.GetBuffs();if(buffs!=null){var neg=buffs.Where(x=>x!=null&&x.buffConfig!=null&&x.buffConfig.dataConfig.data["Type"]=="负面").ToArray();foreach(var b in neg){SetStatusById(t.InstanceId);AddBuff(b.buffConfig.BuffId,"1");}int nt=neg.Select(x=>x.buffConfig.BuffId).Distinct().Count();var re=t.GetBuff(DataId.buff_resentment);int rv=re==null?0:re.buffConfig.Level;if(rv*nt>t.CurHp){SetStatusById(t.InstanceId);Damage(t.CurHp.ToString(),"True");}}}

metadata.NativeSourceApplyScript: AddEvent("StartRound",()=> { for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++) { CreateCard(new DataConfig("cursecard_14", DataType.Card)); } });SetStatus("AllTarget");var targets = new List<IStatusManager>(Object);foreach (var target in targets){ if (target == null) { continue; } string bindId = target.InstanceId; EventCenter.Instance.AddEventListener<HurtData>("Hurt" + bindId, (data) => { if (data.fromDataId != "enemycard_CAR_Sword") { return; } int hurtVal = 0; int.TryParse(data.val, out hurtVal); if (hurtVal <= 0) { return; } int deathSightCount = HandCard.Count(x => x != null && x.dataConfig.data["Id"] == "cursecard_14"); if (deathSightCount <= 5) { return; } var handCopy = HandCard.ToList(); foreach (var card in handCopy){ if (card != null && card.dataConfig.data["Id"] == "cursecard_14") { BurnCardByData(card.dataConfig); }} var hurted = FightManager.Instance.statuses.GetValueOrDefault(bindId, null); if (hurted == null || hurted.state == IStatusManager.State.Dead) { return; } hurted.Hit(hurted.MaxHp, "True", dataConfig.data["Id"], Self.InstanceId); }, this, EventDispose.OnFightEnd);}
